projects.subtitle: Here are some of the projects I've developed. Each one was carefully crafted with attention to detail, performance, and user experience.
projects.github: Check out my GitHub for more
projects.project1Desc: I developed this project using ASP.NET Core 8.0 and SignalR technologies. In this system designed to streamline restaurant order management, users can access the menu by scanning QR codes, place orders, and make reservations. Orders are sent to the kitchen in real time, while all processes can be managed in real time.
projects.project2Desc: I developed a hotel rental website in N-Tier architecture using Asp.Net Core. I implemented secure user registration and login with Asp.Net Identity and JWT. I managed data with Entity Framework Core. I conducted API tests with Swagger and Postman. I validated user data with Fluent Validation and sent user notifications via a mailing system.
projects.project3Desc: I developed this project myself using React. I integrated OpenAI's DALL·E API to allow users to generate AI-powered images based on the text they type. Thanks to the simple and user-friendly interface, users can enter text and view the images generated by the AI. I made effective use of React component structure and API calls, gaining experience with AI technologies while improving my frontend skills.
